snippet.title: DownSouth Kickstarter + Demo  🔴LIVE NOW
snippet.description:
SUPPORT THE KICKSTARTER👉 https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/troopsushi/downsouth
EARLY BIRD REWARD TIERS NOW AVAILABLE!

Play on Steam:
https://downsouth.world/
Join the Discord:
https://discord.gg/M6xF87jxGu

DownSouth is a morality-driven Platformer/RPG. Play as South, a stimulant-fueled purple bean, and parkour, converse and fight your way through sprawling dystopian city-scapes. Each choice affects your abilities, dialogue, and even your appearance... Just know, SURVIVAL comes at a moral cost.

#indiegame #pixelart #rpg #platformer #indiegamedev
